import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Season 6: d170 decision day (pre-gate) vs d174-d189 (actual peak window)
# Water temperature from Scripps Pier
pier_s6 = tables['pier'][(tables['pier']['ts_season'] == 6) & 
                          (tables['pier']['ts_doy'] >= 169) & 
                          (tables['pier']['ts_doy'] <= 190)]

# Convert C to F
pier_s6['wtmp_f'] = (pier_s6['wtmp_c'] * 9/5) + 32

# Get daily water temp (just the 12:00 reading or take mean)
daily_water = pier_s6.groupby('ts_doy').agg({
    'wtmp_f': ['mean', 'min', 'max'],
    'wtmp_c': 'mean'
}).round(2)

print("S06 Water Temperature (Pier) d169-d190:")
print(daily_water)

# Fleet performance by class and day
trips_s6 = tables['trips'][(tables['trips']['fish_date_season'] == 6) &
                            (tables['trips']['fish_date_doy'] >= 169) &
                            (tables['trips']['fish_date_doy'] <= 190)]

fleet_by_day = trips_s6.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'boat': 'count'
}).reset_index()

fleet_by_day['yt_per_angler'] = (fleet_by_day['yt'] / fleet_by_day['anglers']).round(3)
fleet_by_day.columns = ['doy', 'class', 'yt', 'anglers', 'boats', 'yt/angler']

# Max class per day
max_per_day = fleet_by_day.loc[fleet_by_day.groupby('doy')['yt/angler'].idxmax()]
print("\nS06 Max Class Performance (yt/angler) by Day d169-d190:")
print(max_per_day[['doy', 'class', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt/angler']].to_string(index=False))

# 7-day rolling mean
water_series = daily_water['wtmp_f'].mean()
rolling_7d = water_series.rolling(7, center=False).mean()
print("\nS06 7-Day Water Temp Mean (rolling):")
for day in range(169, 191):
    if day in rolling_7d.index:
        print(f"  d{day}: {rolling_7d[day]:.1f}°F")
